title: Hardware-Aware Quantum Support Vector Machines
summary: Deploying quantum machine learning algorithms on near-term quantum hardware requires circuits that respect device-specific gate sets, connectivity constraints, and noise characteristics. We present a hardware-aware Neural Architecture Search (NAS) approach for designing quantum feature maps that are natively executable on IBM quantum processors without transpilation overhead.
